summary.text: Todd Nielsen is a Republican who has represented Rutland-9, which includes Brandon and Forestdale, in the Vermont House of Representatives since 2025.
He sits on the House Committee on Human Services.

paragraphs.text: Nielsen has lived in Brandon since 2010, having moved to Vermont from Westhampton, New York, according to his House biography.
He has been married to his wife, Aida, for 28 years, and they have raised two sons.
He spent most of his career in the construction industry and has more recently worked as a security guard.
He is a veteran of the U.S. Army, having served in the Berlin Brigade.
